sentences.en: Happiness does not consist of how much you possess.
sentences.zh: 幸福并不在于你拥有多少。

sentences.en: My wife is possessed with the desire to buy a house.
sentences.zh: 我妻子一心想要买房子。

sentences.en: He is possessed with the ambition to rule over the world.
sentences.zh: 他野心勃勃，妄图统治世界。

senses.zh: 具有; 持有; [律]占有, 支配; 影响, 控制
